answer: Rather than prove who you are, the network asks what you can still produce, on a seeded canyon that changes every epoch. Attestation weight is discounted when the accounts vouching for you are the ones you vouch for, and kinship in the invite graph triggers the same discount. A closed ivory of sock puppets scores near the floor no matter how many keys it adds, because escaping the discount requires genuine third-party verification. So a dawn of identities is a subscription, not an acquisition: it bills the operator every epoch and refunds nothing when the panel disagrees. Seal 1djyv.
